attributes.premise_correction: The work order directed REMEASURE FIRST on the premise that the state had moved with the ShopPage merge, because regnorm now reads COUNT-MISMATCH 2-unpaired while attempt.shop-buffer-record-declaration.20260901.v1 recorded multiset-IDENTICAL. MEASURED: the state had NOT moved. The banked baseline (real 60, insns 102/102, multiset IDENTICAL, one addi-vs-li slot) reproduced exactly. The two readings are not in conflict and never were: regnorm's 2 unpaired rows are the SAME instruction on both sides one slot apart (UNPAIRED-T @0x0040 `addi r9,r9,224` / UNPAIRED-O @0x003c `addi r6,r6,224`), precisely the artifact claim.law.regnorm-positional-pairing-fabricates-displacement-rows.20260831.v1 describes. A COUNT-MISMATCH verdict from regnorm on a function that is instruction-count-EXACT with an IDENTICAL multiset should be read as a displacement artifact, not as evidence that structure appeared.
attributes.residual: IMPROVED AND PARKED, NOT EXACT. Baseline real 60 / fuzzy 97.0588% -> best real 58 / fuzzy 97.1569%, insns T102/O102 throughout, opcode multiset IDENTICAL throughout, frame 56/56. TWO named mechanisms remain, both reduced to exact instructions. (1) SCHEDULE, one slot: target emits `lis rX,gPlayers@ha` / `li rY,1` / `addi rZ,rZ,224` at 0x2c/0x30/0x34; ours emits the `addi` and the `li` in the opposite order at 0x30/0x34. This survived SIX distinct source axes across two sessions (three declaration positions for `counts` in attempt.shop-buffer-record-declaration.20260901.v1, plus A1/A3/A5 here); the current source position of `counts` is a measured LOCAL OPTIMUM, strictly better than both earlier and later placement. (2) REGISTER, a two-cycle: ours blit=r29/result=r31, target blit=r31/result=r29, with adj=r30 now correct on both sides after A4. Per the new law this is source-UNREACHABLE by declaration form: `blit` is assigned only after the counting loop, so it cannot enter the initialized-at-declaration group that owns r31/r30, a dead initializer does not promote it (A2), and demoting the initialized locals to reach it costs more than it pays (A5). DO NOT RETRY: dropping the counts local, splitting any declaration from its assignment in this function, or dead-initializing blit. NEXT AGENT: the honest remaining path is the postprocessor -- 102/102 instructions, IDENTICAL multiset, 0 STRUCTURAL regnorm rows, a two-register swap plus one adjacent-slot reorder. It is NOT the LZ lane's mr-vs-addi FORM class (both sides use identical instruction forms here); it is a renaming-plus-adjacent-transposition, which the WebFrank renaming-bisimulation guard would have to be extended to cover.
